issues.problem: how value 何度も繰り返して言いました (said it again several times) does not make speech audible to distant listeners, so the ように purpose clause is illogical in every combination
issues.action: replaced with マイクの音量を上げました (turned up the microphone volume)

issues.problem: listener value 外にいる人 (the people outside) clashes with how values 前に出て話しました / 立ち上がって話しました (stepping forward or standing up does not help people outside hear)
issues.action: replaced with 会場の後ろにいる人 (the people at the back of the hall)

issues.problem: help value 協力 (cooperation) is odd with personal results such as passing an exam, finishing a thesis or getting used to a new life
act value 集合場所を間違えた (going to the wrong meeting place) implies a group gathering and does not fit results such as the job interview, the plane or the film
issues.action: replaced with 駅の出口を間違えた (taking the wrong station exit)

issues.problem: from value 店の窓 (the shop window) reads as a display window and is an odd vantage point for watching the street
issues.action: replaced with 台所の窓 (the kitchen window)
